WHEREAS it is
expedient further to amend the Emigration Ordinance,1979 (XVII of 1979), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as
follows:
1. Short title and
commencement. (1) This Act shall be called the Emigration (Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
